note.zh-TW: 現行 IAS 7.34 允許列營業或籌資，教材列籌資；IFRS 18 修正 IAS 7 後一般企業一律列籌資活動。
note.en: Current IAS 7.34 allows operating or financing and the course uses financing; after the IFRS 18 amendments most entities must classify it as financing.

definition.zh-TW: 發給股東的現金股利。本課的故事沒有發股利。
definition.en: Cash dividends paid to shareholders. The course story pays no dividend.
